title: 100 µL from a 1-well reservoir to wells A1 to A12

steps.source_quote: Add 100 uL of liquid from a 1-well reservoir to wells A1->A12 in a 96-well plate.
steps.note: 12 x 100 µL = 1200 µL exceeds one pipette load, so the robot layer must re-aspirate partway

assumptions: A1->A12 means row A, columns 1 to 12 (letters are rows, numbers are columns)
total 1200 µL is more than one pipette load (P300 holds 300 µL), so the pipette must re-aspirate
